_note: Explanation of each item for the «More information» sheet (what you will find and when it helps). Hand-written and reviewable; data (articles, dates, chapters) comes from catalog.json and catalog-kiwix.json, never from here.

items.wikipedia-medicina: All of Spanish Wikipedia's medicine and health articles: diseases, symptoms, drugs, anatomy and procedures, with illustrations.
items.medlineplus: The patient health encyclopedia of the U.S. National Library of Medicine, in Spanish: diseases, tests, medicines, herbs and supplements, with videos and drawings, in plain language.
items.medlineplus-en: The health encyclopedia of the U.S. National Library of Medicine, written for patients in plain language: diseases, tests, medicines, herbs and supplements, with videos and drawings. Ideal to check usual doses, side effects and when something is serious.
items.zimgit-medicine: A collection of complete books on field and emergency medicine (advanced first aid, expedition and remote-area medicine). Useful when medical help is days away.
items.military-medicine: U.S. military manuals on combat and field medicine: bleeding control, tourniquets, airway, casualty evacuation and prolonged care without a hospital. Very practical for serious trauma.
items.cdc-travel: The U.S. CDC travelers' health guide: diseases by country and region, vaccines, safe food and water, bites, altitude and tropical diseases. Useful if you live or travel outside Europe.
items.mdwiki: A medical encyclopedia in English reviewed by doctors from WikiProjectMed: diseases, drugs, procedures and anatomy. Your main medical reference if you use English. Helps you understand what is happening to someone when you cannot ask a doctor.
items.wikipedia-medicina-fr: All of French Wikipedia's medicine and health articles, with illustrations.
items.wikipedia-medicina-it: All of Italian Wikipedia's medicine and health articles, with illustrations.
items.ready-gov: The U.S. government's official disaster preparedness site, in Spanish: family plans, emergency kits and what to do in floods, hurricanes, earthquakes, fires, blackouts, heat waves or pandemics.
items.ready-gov-en: The U.S. government's official disaster preparedness site: how to make a family plan and an emergency kit, and what to do in floods, hurricanes, earthquakes, fires, blackouts, heat waves or pandemics. Very clear, step by step.
items.zimgit-post-disaster: A library for after a disaster: shelter, water, sanitation, energy, communication, food and community organisation when services are down for weeks.
items.zimgit-water: Books and guides on collecting, storing and purifying water: home-made filters, disinfection, wells and rainwater. Small and very useful: water comes first.
items.zimgit-food: Recipes and techniques to preserve and prepare food from an emergency pantry: canning, drying, cooking without electricity and making the most of what you have.
items.zimgit-knots: An illustrated collection of knots and lashings: climbing, fishing, loads, rope ladders and even sutures. The drawings speak for themselves.
items.scoutwiki: The Scout encyclopedia in Spanish: camping, orienteering, knots, fire, games and outdoor activities for beginners.
items.scoutwiki-it: The Scout encyclopedia in Italian: camping, orienteering, knots and outdoor activities.
items.scoutwiki-en: The Scout encyclopedia in English, the largest of the three: camping, orienteering, knots, fire, games and outdoor activities explained for beginners.
items.outdoors-qa: Stack Exchange community Q&A on mountains, camping and survival: gear, hypothermia, wildlife, navigation, water in the wild. Concrete answers to real questions.
items.armypubs: U.S. Army manuals and publications: survival, first aid, navigation, communications, vehicle maintenance, construction and much more. Huge (over 8 GB); for those who want the full technical reference.
items.wikipedia: The whole Spanish Wikipedia, without images so it takes less space: over a million articles on any subject.
items.wikipedia-fr: The whole French Wikipedia, without images. For those using the device in French.
items.wikipedia-it: The whole Italian Wikipedia, without images. For those using the device in Italian.
items.wikipedia-en: English Wikipedia, the largest. By default only the introduction of each article so it takes less space; full versions are also available. Your everyday encyclopedia for anything that is not an emergency.
items.wiktionary: Spanish Wiktionary: definitions, synonyms, etymology, conjugations and translations.
items.wiktionary-fr: French Wiktionary: definitions, conjugations and translations.
items.wiktionary-it: Italian Wiktionary: definitions, conjugations and translations.
items.wiktionary-en: English Wiktionary: definitions, pronunciation, etymology and translations into many languages. Very large (almost 15 GB), so it is not ticked by default.
items.wikivoyage: Spanish Wikivoyage: travel guide with cities, regions, transport and safety tips.
items.wikivoyage-fr: The Wikivoyage travel guide in French.
items.wikivoyage-it: The Wikivoyage travel guide in Italian.
items.wikivoyage-en: The English Wikivoyage, the most complete: cities, regions, transport, lodging and safety tips for many destinations. Useful to get around somewhere you don't know, offline.
items.wikisource-fr: French Wikisource: complete public-domain texts. Very large; not ticked by default.
items.wikisource-en: English Wikisource: complete public-domain texts such as literary classics, historical laws, documents and poetry.
items.ifixit: Thousands of step-by-step repair guides with photos, in Spanish: phones, computers, appliances, cars, bikes, clothes and tools.
items.ifixit-en: Thousands of step-by-step repair guides with photos: phones, computers, appliances, cars, bikes, clothes and tools. To fix what breaks when there is no technician and no new spare parts.
items.lowtech: Low-Tech Magazine: articles on simple, low-energy technologies that work off the grid, such as home-made solar and wind power, heating, food preservation, transport and traditional tools.
items.appropedia: A wiki on appropriate technology: how to build solar cookers, water filters, latrines, greenhouses, pumps and small energy systems with local materials.
items.energypedia: A wiki on renewable energy and energy access: solar panels, batteries, biogas, micro-hydro and efficiency, with practical cases.
items.diy-qa: Stack Exchange Q&A on DIY and home improvement: electrical, plumbing, carpentry, damp and heating. To solve concrete problems around the house.
items.gardening-qa: Stack Exchange Q&A on gardening and growing food: pests, plant diseases, soil, watering and pruning.
items.mechanics-qa: Stack Exchange Q&A on car, truck and motorcycle mechanics: breakdowns, noises, maintenance and repairs.
items.ham-qa: Stack Exchange Q&A on amateur radio: antennas, propagation, equipment, licences and emergency communications.
items.cooking-qa: Stack Exchange Q&A on cooking: techniques, ingredient substitutions, preservation and food safety.
items.sustainability-qa: Stack Exchange Q&A on sustainable living: saving water and energy, compost, recycling and self-sufficiency.
items.wikibooks: Spanish Wikibooks: free manuals and textbooks.
items.wikibooks-fr: French Wikibooks: free manuals and textbooks.
items.wikibooks-it: Italian Wikibooks: free manuals and textbooks.
items.wikibooks-en: English Wikibooks, the largest collection of free manuals and textbooks: languages, maths, computing, cooking and more.
items.gutenberg: Project Gutenberg's books in Spanish: over a thousand public-domain classics.
items.gutenberg-fr: Project Gutenberg's books in French: thousands of public-domain classics.
items.gutenberg-it: Project Gutenberg's books in Italian: public-domain classics.
items.gutenberg-en: All of Project Gutenberg's books in English: over 80,000 public-domain works. Huge (over 200 GB); not ticked by default.
items.wikiversity: Spanish Wikiversity: open courses and learning materials.
items.wikiversity-fr: French Wikiversity: open courses and learning materials.
items.wikiversity-it: Italian Wikiversity: open courses and learning materials.
items.wikiversity-en: English Wikiversity: open courses and learning materials, the most complete.
items.phet: PhET interactive science and maths simulations, in Spanish.
items.phet-fr: PhET interactive science and maths simulations, in French.
items.phet-it: PhET interactive science and maths simulations, in Italian.
items.phet-en: Interactive physics, chemistry, biology and maths simulations from the University of Colorado (PhET): circuits, forces, waves, fractions… Great for children and adults to keep learning without Internet.
items.mapa-espana: The map of mainland Spain and the Balearic Islands down to street level: roads, tracks, trails, rivers, terrain, buildings and points of interest (pharmacies, hospitals, springs, petrol stations). Works like an online map, but without Internet.
items.mapa-canarias: The map of the Canary Islands with the same detail as the mainland: streets, tracks, terrain and points of interest.
items.mapa-mundo: A general map of the whole world with countries, cities, main roads and terrain, without street detail. Very small, and helps you place yourself anywhere.
items.rutas-espana: Offline routing data for mainland Spain and the Balearics: on foot, by bike or by car, with distance and estimated time. Needs the map of Spain too.
items.rutas-canarias: Offline routing data for the Canary Islands: on foot, by bike or by car. Needs the Canary Islands map too.
items.@country-map: The map of your country down to street level: roads, tracks, terrain and points of interest (pharmacies, hospitals, springs, petrol stations). Works without Internet.
items.@country-routing: Offline routing data for your country, on foot, by bike or by car, with distance and estimated time. Needs the country map too.
items.asistente: An artificial intelligence assistant that runs inside the device, without Internet. Ask in your own words and it answers using the emergency protocols and the downloaded library, citing where it got it from. The recommended model if the device has enough memory.
items.asistente-gemma3: An alternative model for the assistant (Google's Gemma 3). It answers somewhat differently from the recommended one; useful to compare.
items.asistente-llama32: An alternative model for the assistant (Meta's Llama 3.2), a bit smaller and faster than the recommended one.
items.asistente-ligero: A smaller, faster assistant for devices with little memory, such as 3–4 GB tablets or phones. Weaker answers than the recommended one, but it works where the big one doesn't fit.
items.juegos: A complete copy of the Viseni Games collection to play on the device without Internet, from the «Games» button. To keep children and adults entertained during long waits or power cuts.
items.hesperian-donde-no-hay-doctor: The world's most used health book for places without a doctor (Spanish edition of «Where There Is No Doctor»). If you can only take one health manual, take this one.
items.oms-atencion-basica-emergencia: For anyone who must care for injured or seriously ill people in the first minutes or hours, with an orderly method so nothing urgent is forgotten.
items.msf-medicamentos-esenciales: To know which medicine to give, at what dose and when not to give it, with whatever is in a first-aid kit.
items.msf-clinical-guidelines-en: Médecins Sans Frontières' reference to diagnose and treat without a hospital. Useful if someone in the group has health training.
items.oms-primera-ayuda-psicologica: To help someone in shock, afraid or grieving after a disaster. You don't need to be a psychologist.
items.cicr-primeros-auxilios-conflictos: First aid when there is also danger around: how to protect yourself and decide whom to treat first.
items.ifrc-tratamiento-agua-hogar-emergencias: To have safe water at home when the tap is unreliable. With easy-to-follow drawings.
items.hesperian-salud-ambiental: To prevent disease in a community: clean water, latrines, mosquitoes and waste.
items.ops-gestion-cadaveres-desastres: For response teams or isolated communities who must deal with the dead after a disaster, respectfully and without unnecessary risks.
items.hesperian-libro-parteras: To attend a birth or a pregnancy with no professionals nearby.
items.ops-complicaciones-embarazo-parto: For health workers facing an obstetric emergency: what to do by symptom.
items.hesperian-donde-no-hay-dentista: To relieve toothache or treat a dental infection without a dentist.
items.hesperian-donde-no-hay-doctor-mujeres: Women's health throughout life, when there is no doctor nearby.
items.cawst-tratamiento-agua-domiciliar: To teach others to make water safe at home step by step, with several safety barriers.
items.cawst-saneamiento-ambiental: To organise latrines, waste and hygiene and so prevent diarrhoea outbreaks.
items.ops-tratamiento-diarrea: Diarrhoea kills through dehydration: this manual says how much fluid to give and how.
items.oms-brote-diarrea-aguda: What to do in the first days if many people start having diarrhoea at the same time.
items.oms-guia-humanitaria-mhgap: To handle serious mental health problems in an emergency without specialists.
items.ops-victimas-en-masa: To get organised when there are many injured and few resources.
items.oms-aps-ninos-adolescentes: To look after children's and teenagers' health and know when something is urgent.
items.cicr-cirugia-guerra-vol1: Reference for health workers who must treat serious wounds with minimal resources.
items.cicr-cirugia-guerra-vol2: Continuation of volume 1, by body region. For health workers.
items.oms-guias-calidad-agua: The world technical reference on drinking water. For whoever manages the water of a group or community.
items.cawst-analisis-calidad-agua: To check whether water is safe with simple field tests.
items.ops-wash-coordinacion-emergencias: For whoever coordinates a community's water and sanitation after a disaster.
items.oms-enfermedades-agua-hogares: Which home water treatment methods really work, and why.
items.ops-salud-mental-desastres: To understand and support emotional reactions after a disaster, including those of the helpers.
items.ops-salud-mental-promotor: For neighbours and volunteers who want to support people with mental health problems.
items.oms-mhgap-2: For non-specialist health workers facing mental, neurological or substance-use disorders.
items.oms-paludismo-grave: Essential if you are in a malaria area.
items.oms-tetanos-emergencias: After a disaster there are many dirty wounds: how to prevent and treat tetanus.
items.oms-malnutricion-grave: To treat children or adults with severe malnutrition without harming them when refeeding.
items.oms-uso-clinico-sangre-bolsillo: For health workers facing severe bleeding and transfusions.
items.oms-higiene-entorno-sanitario: To set up an improvised care post without spreading infections.
items.ops-primera-ayuda-psicologica-comunidad: Psychological first aid explained with drawings for anyone.
items.hesperian-aprendiendo-promover-salud: To train other people as community health promoters.
items.msf-cholera-epidemic-en: To respond to a cholera outbreak.
items.msf-public-health-engineering-en: To set up water, latrines and waste management in a camp.
items.oms-surgical-care-district-hospital-en: Basic surgical techniques for health workers.
items.pc-guia-autoproteccion: Spain's official Civil Protection guide for any emergency.
items.guia-familias-autoproteccion-2025: To prepare the whole family: emergency plan, basic kit and what to do for each risk (Spain).
items.pc-guia-inundaciones: What to do in a flood according to Spain's Civil Protection.
items.pc-guia-fenomenos-meteorologicos: What to do in heat and cold waves, storms, snowfall or strong winds.
items.pc-guia-riesgo-quimico-nuclear: What to do if there is a nearby factory accident, chemical leak or nuclear incident.
items.ign-terremoto-tsunami: What to do before, during and after an earthquake, and how to act on a tsunami warning.
items.sanidad-calor-folleto: To protect elderly people, children and the sick during a heat wave.
items.ifrc-kit-alojamiento: To improvise a shelter with a tarp and rope when you cannot go home.
items.ops-wash-tratamiento-agua: To make water drinkable with exact chlorine doses, by boiling or with sunlight.
items.ops-wash-almacenamiento-agua: To store water at home without it getting contaminated.
items.ops-wash-saneamiento: To build emergency latrines in the first days.
items.scouts-manual-orientacion: To find your way with a map and compass, or without them, in the countryside.
items.scouts-manual-cabuyeria: Useful knots and lashings for building shelters and structures.
items.iaru-guia-telecom-emergencia: To communicate by radio when phones and the Internet fail.
items.ure-manual-control-red: To run or take part in an emergency radio net in Spain.
items.ign-actividades-mtn: To really learn to read a topographic map: contour lines, scale and terrain.
items.atp-3-50-21-survival: The current U.S. Army survival manual.
items.fm-3-25-26-land-navigation: To navigate with map and compass without GPS, in full detail.
items.fm-21-76-survival: The classic survival manual, with drawings of edible and poisonous plants.
items.fao-una-huerta-para-todos: To grow your own food in a family garden from scratch.
items.fao-huertos-familiares-urbanos: To grow in pots, balconies and terraces.
items.fao-huerto-escolar: To run a garden together, at a school or in the neighbourhood.
items.fao-conservacion-frutas-hortalizas: To make the harvest last for months without a fridge.
items.fao-silos-metalicos-familiares: To store grain and pulses for months without spoiling.
items.fao-captacion-agua-lluvia: To collect and store rainwater at home or in the countryside.
items.fao-avicultura-familiar: To raise hens at home for eggs and meat.
items.fao-conejo-cria: To raise rabbits: a simple, efficient source of meat.
